entries.description: Low-observable air-launched standoff cruise missile designed to defeat dense air defense networks; declared operational 2003; >2,000 procured with plans for up to 10,000; stealth design evades S-300-class defenses; compatible with B-1B (up to 24), B-2 (16), B-52H (12), F-15E, F-16, F/A-18; CEP within 3 m.

Guidance: INS + GPS with terminal imaging infrared and Automatic Target Recognition (ATR)

Dimensions: Length 5.1 m; Diameter 0.48 m; Wingspan 3.0 m

entries.description: Long-range subsonic cruise missile launched from surface-ship vertical launch systems and submarine torpedo tubes; used by the US Navy, UK Royal Navy and Royal Australian Navy; extensively combat-proven since the 1991 Gulf War; Block V extends range and capability.

Guidance: GPS, INS, TERCOM, DSMAC, two-way data link
Dimensions: Length 5.56 m (w/o booster), 6.25 m (w/ booster); Diameter 0.52 m; Wingspan 2.67 m

entries.description: Fifth-generation long-range anti-ship missile with land-attack mode; low-observable shape, super sea skim, high-G random maneuvers and I3R intelligent imaging infrared seeker with Autonomous Target Recognition (ATR); in service on Norwegian Fridtjof Nansen class frigates and Skjold class corvettes and the Polish coastal system; also selected by the US Navy; sea-skimming flight close to terrain.
specs: Type: anti-ship missile (with land attack mode)
Operators: Norway, Poland (also selected by US Navy)
Range NSM: greater than 100 nautical miles (~185 km)
Weight NSM: total 407 kg; warhead 120 kg
Propulsion: solid-fuel rocket booster, Microturbo TRI-40 turbojet
Seeker: I3R imaging infrared with Autonomous Target Recognition (ATR)

entries.description: Supersonic ramjet-powered anti-ship cruise missile; launched from ships, submarines, aircraft and the Bastion-P coastal defense system; terminal sea-skimming approach at 10-15 m; combat-proven in the Syrian Civil War and the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine; developed jointly with India.
specs: Country users: India, Indonesia, Russia, Syria, Vietnam
Engine: rocket booster for initial acceleration; ramjet powered by kerosene for sustained supersonic flight

Launchers: naval ships (vertical/inclined), submarines, fixed-wing aircraft (Yakhont-M), Bastion-P coastal defense system
Dimensions: Length 8.6 m; Diameter 0.67 m; Wingspan 1.7 m

entries.description: Beyond-visual-range air-to-air missile with surface-to-air capability; in service since September 1991; combat-proven since the Gulf War; used by over 35 countries; AIM-120C-5/6/7 capable of 40G; unit cost ~$1,090,000 (AIM-120D, FY2019); launched from fighters, ground systems and naval vessels.

entries.description: Turkish-made tactical Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) designed for intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance (ISR) and precision strike missions, developed by Baykar Makina. It completed its first flight in 2014 and entered service with the Turkish Armed Forces in 2015.

Armament: MAM-C, MAM-L miniature air-to-ground munitions, Smart Micro Munition (SMM)

entries.description: Medium-to-high altitude, long-endurance remotely piloted aircraft system (UAS), capable of remote-controlled or autonomous flight, developed by General Atomics Aeronautical Systems (GA-ASI). Its primary mission is as a persistent hunter-killer; its secondary mission is intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance.

Sensors: AN/APY-8 Lynx II radar, AN/DAS-1 MTS-B Multi-Spectral Targeting System
Country users: France, India, Italy, Netherlands, Spain, United Kingdom, United States

entries.description: Iranian-made loitering ammunition, also called a suicide or kamikaze drone, developed and manufactured by Iran Aircraft Manufacturing Industrial Company (HESA). Unveiled in 2021, it is used by the Russian army in Ukraine and can be launched in a drone-swarming, multiple-launch format.
specs: Engine: MADO MD-550 piston engine, 50 hp (Iranian copy of the German Limbach L550E)
Guidance: inertial navigation system with consumer-grade GPS

entries.description: Chinese Medium-Altitude Long-Endurance (MALE) armed reconnaissance/strike unmanned aerial vehicle, an improved version of the Wing Loong I designed and manufactured by the Aviation Industry Corporation of China (AVIC), developed primarily for the export market.

Armament: up to 12 laser-guided bombs or missiles including FT-9/50 50 kg bomb, GB3 250 kg laser-guided bomb, TL-10 bomb; 3 underwing hardpoints per wing

alt_names: Uran-9 UGV Unmanned Ground Combat Vehicle

Dimensions: L 5.12 m; W 2.53 m; H 2.5 m

Protection: against small arms fire and shell splinters

entries.description: Single-seat, single-engine, all-weather multirole fighter aircraft developed by General Dynamics (now Lockheed Martin). The F-16A is the single-seat variant while the F-16B is the two-seat training version; the aircraft is one of the most widely used fighters in the world.
specs: Type: Multirole fighter (single-seat F-16A, two-seat F-16B)

Operational range: 2,220 km (1,380 mi) with internal fuel
Armament: M61A2 Vulcan 20 mm cannon; AIM-120 AMRAAM; AIM-9X Sidewinder; GBU-31 JDAM; GBU-39 Small Diameter Bomb; AGM-88 HARM; Meteor, JASSM and Maverick for export customers

entries.description: Russian-made mobile broadband multifunctional jamming station intended to neutralize Low-Earth Orbit spy satellites, ground-based radars, and airborne radars (AWACS) at ranges between 150 to 300 km. Dimensions: L 9.87 m; W 2.78 m; H 3.26 m

entries.description: The LMV SF is the special-forces variant of the Iveco Defence Vehicles Light Multirole Vehicle (LMV), a 4x4 light tactical vehicle built on the proven LMV chassis, deployed in Afghanistan by four different nations. It features independent suspension, central tyre inflation and ABS; modular armor protects against small arms and mine blast, and is upgradable with add-on armor packs or an optional anti-mine plate. The vehicle is transportable by CH-47 Chinook and tactical transport aircraft in its reduced-width configuration.
specs: Max speed: 110 km/h (on road, over 110 km/h)
Engine: 140 kW, power-to-weight ratio about 20 kW/t
Transmission: six-speed automatic with hydrodynamic coupling converter and transfer box
Armor: modular protection against small arms and mine blast
Features: independent suspension, central tyre inflation, ABS

entries.description: The FAMAS is a bullpup assault rifle chambered in 5.56 mm NATO, the standard rifle of the French army since the 1980s. First presented in 1973 and ordered in 1979; production ceased in 2000 with the closure of the Saint-Étienne plant (maintenance now handled by Nexter Mechanics Tulle). It uses the American 5.56 mm M193 cartridge and features a three-position fire selector offering single shot, automatic and 3-round burst fire, plus a bipod, bayonet lug and a forward sight mount for grenade launching.
specs: Fire modes: single shot, automatic, 3-round burst
Variants: FAMAS Commando (405 mm barrel), F1, G1, G2

entries.description: The M16A2 is the more recent variant of the M16 assault rifle family, featuring a heavier barrel and modified to fire the SS109 5.56 mm NATO cartridge. Gas-operated with a rotating bolt. The M16 was designed by Eugene Stoner (Armalite) and produced by Colt; adopted in 1961, it became the M16A1 in 1966 with the addition of a forward-assist bolt closure mechanism developed from Vietnam experience.

sources.label: Army Recognition product page (M16 / M16A1, covers M16A2)

Designed to perform both air superiority and precision strike missions, the Su-57 integrates advanced stealth technology, supermaneuverability, and sustained supersonic speeds, marking Russia's first operational stealth fighter.

Armament: MICA air-to-air missiles (IR and EM), AASM precision-guided weapons, SCALP long-range stand-off missiles, Exocet anti-ship missiles, laser-guided bombs, Nexter 30 M 791 30-mm gun (2,500 rounds/min), METEOR (upcoming)

entries.description: The principal shipborne electronic warfare system carried by major US Navy surface ships, with more than 450 systems produced and in operation around the globe since the 1980s. Capability: ship-profile recognition within a group of ships; engagement of specific areas (bridge, CIC, helicopter hangar, sensors)

Compatibility: fits existing MM40 installation and launch systems

entries.description: The JLTV (Joint Light Tactical Vehicle) was developed by Oshkosh Defense to provide a new generation of 4x4 armored vehicles for the US Army and Marine Corps. In September 2011 Oshkosh unveiled the L-ATV Light Combat Tactical All-Terrain Vehicle, which was selected for the JLTV Engineering, Manufacturing, and Development phase. In August 2015 TACOM awarded Oshkosh Defense a $6.7 billion production contract for the JLTV. The vehicle is designed to be transported by US military transport aircraft or airlifted by CH-47 Chinook helicopter.

Armor: scalable armored capsule, advanced armor solutions protecting against small arms, IED blasts, and artillery shell splinters

Country users: Belgium, Brazil, Lithuania, Montenegro/North Macedonia, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, United States

entries.manufacturer: Vickers Defence Systems (now BAE Systems Land and Armaments)
entries.description: The Challenger 2 FV4034 is the main battle tank in service with the British Army, built by Vickers Defence Systems (later BAE Systems Land and Armaments). It is an extensive redesign from Challenger 1, with fewer than 5% of components interchangeable. It entered service with the British Army in June 1998 and the last of 386 tanks were delivered in April 2002. In 2023 the UK announced the supply of Challenger 2 tanks to Ukraine.
specs: Armament: one 120mm L30A rifled tank gun, two 7.62mm machine guns, two banks of five 66mm grenade launchers
Range: 550 km (450 km by road / 250 km cross country per description)
Dimensions: length 13.05 m; width 4.2 m; height 2.49 m
Engine: 12-cylinder Perkins Caterpillar CV12 diesel, 1,200 hp, David Brown TN54 gearbox (6 forward, 2 reverse)
Accessories: fire control system, NBC system, night vision system, dozer blade, laser range-finder, diesel fuel smoke laying
Country users: United Kingdom, Oman, Ukraine

entries.description: The Leopard 2A8 is the latest variant of the Leopard 2 main battle tank family, developed and manufactured by the German companies KMW and Rheinmetall as an improved version of the Leopard 2A7. A demonstrator was unveiled at IDET in May 2023. Germany ordered 18 tanks in May 2023 with an option for 105 more, and in July 2024 the German MoD ordered the first 105 units. The Czech Republic ordered 70, the Netherlands 46 in October 2024, Lithuania 54, and Croatia up to 50.
specs: Armament: 120mm L55 smoothbore cannon, 7.62mm coaxial machine gun, Trophy APS countermeasure launcher
Armor: new generation of active and passive all-around armor against ATGW and RPG threats
Dimensions: length 7.7 m; width 4.0 m; height 3.0 m
Gradient: 60%; side slope 30%; vertical obstacle 1.15 m; trench 3 m; fording 1 m (4 m prepared)
Country users: Croatia, Czech Republic, Lithuania, Norway, Germany

entries.manufacturer: Chrysler Corporation (later General Dynamics Land Systems)
entries.description: The M1 is the first variant of the US Abrams series main battle tank, developed from 1971 to answer a US Army request. The Chrysler Corporation prototype was selected in November 1976 to enter Full-Scale Engineering Development. Total production of the M1 was 2,374 tanks, the last delivered in February 1985. The M1 is no longer in service with the US military, most having been upgraded to M1A1 and M1A2 standard.
specs: Armament: one 105mm gun (M68A1 rifled), one 7.62mm coaxial machine gun, one 12.7mm anti-aircraft machine gun
Dimensions: length 7.91 m; width 3.65 m; height 2.88 m
Engine: Textron Lycoming AGT 1500 gas turbine, 1,500 hp
Suspension: torsion bar with seven road wheels

entries.description: The U.S. Army M977 A2 HEMTT series mobility tactical truck was developed by Oshkosh Truck Corporation for cross-country military missions carrying payloads up to 13 tons. The family includes five cargo trucks, a fuel servicing truck and a load handling system. The M977 A2 vehicles are used for direct rearming of the MLRS, transport of Patriot erectors/launchers, resupply of field artillery ammunition, forward area refueling, and recovery of disabled vehicles.
specs: Chassis: 8x8 wheeled vehicle, front and rear tandem single-reduction axles with inter-axle differential locks
Load weight: 28,123 kg (GVWR range 28,123 - 43,091 kg); payload 22,000 lbs (9,979 kg)
Engine: DDC Model 8V92TA, 445 hp, 12.1 liter DDEC4 diesel
Transmission: Allison HD4560P 6-speed automatic, Oshkosh 55,000/2-speed transfer case
Fording: up to 48 inches (1,219 mm) deep; can climb a 60% grade with full payload
Variants: M977 A2 Cargo, M978 A2 tanker, M983 A2 LET/Patriot tractor, M984 A2 recovery, M985 A2 cargo/MLRS, M1120 A2 LHS, M1977 A2 CBT
Country users: United States, Bahrain, Egypt, Greece, Israel, South Korea, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Taiwan

entries.description: The T-90M Model 2017, nicknamed Proryv-3, is an upgraded variant of the export T-90MS main battle tank developed and designed by the Russian company Uralvagonzavod, improved in protection, mobility, and firepower. It was tested during the Zapad-2017 exercise and upgraded based on Russian combat experience in Syria. The first T-90M tanks were delivered to the 1st Guards Tank Army in April 2020 and the tank has been used in combat during the 2022 war in Ukraine.
specs: Armament: one 125mm 2A46M-4 smoothbore gun (capable of firing Refleks ATGM, AT-11 Sniper-B, range up to 5,000 m), one PKT 7.62mm coaxial machine gun, one NSVT 12.7mm machine gun in remote weapon station
Ammunition: 43 rounds for 125mm, 1,250 rounds 7.62mm, 300 rounds 12.7mm; automatic carousel loader with 22 ready rounds
Armor: new all-welded turret with Relikt ERA, RPG metal net, bar-slat armor
Dimensions: length 6.68 m; width 3.78 m; height 2.23 m
Engine: V-92S2, 1,000 hp, manual transmission 7 forward/1 reverse
Combat equipment: NBC protection, fire detection/suppression, dozer blade, deep fording kit, active protection system, modern fire control system

entries.designation: AN/ALQ-249(V)1 Next Generation Jammer - Mid Band (NGJ-MB)
entries.description: Airborne electronic attack jammer pods fitted to US Navy EA-18G Growlers, engineered to deny, disrupt and degrade enemy technologies including communication tools and air-defense systems, with significantly enhanced ranges and the ability to engage multiple targets simultaneously. Uses active electronically scanned array (AESA) antennas and a modular open architecture.
specs: Capabilities: jams radar-guided missile signals and communications; engages multiple targets simultaneously

sources.label: Army Recognition - Focus: NGJ-MB pods on US Navy EA-18G Growlers

entries.description: Russia's largest firearms manufacturer Izhmash unveiled a prototype of its new Kalashnikov AK-12 assault rifle in February 2012 with improved ergonomics and tactical flexibility, designed as a basic platform for nearly 20 different modifications. The AK-12 was presented to the public in June 2012 at the Engineer Technologies exhibition in Moscow and started entering service with Russian army units in 2020.
specs: Operation: gas-operated, long-stroke gas piston, rotary bolt locking, selective fire (single shot, 3-round burst, automatic)
Features: folding stock with height-adjustable heelpiece, Picatinny rails, ambidextrous controls, hinged rigid top cover, can fire barrel-mounted grenades

entries.description: The FN SCAR L MK2 is a modular 5.56x45mm NATO assault rifle developed by FN Herstal for both close-quarters battle and general-purpose infantry roles. It is available with two interchangeable cold hammer-forged barrels, a 254mm (10 inch) CQC version and a 368mm (14.5 inch) standard version, both swappable in the field without re-zeroing the optics. It operates with a short-stroke gas piston system and rotating bolt, and is fed by standard 30-round STANAG-compatible magazines.
specs: Operation: gas operated, rotating bolt, short stroke piston
Length: CQC 788 mm extended / 724 mm collapsed / 540 mm folded; STD 903 mm extended / 840 mm collapsed / 655 mm folded
Barrel length: 254 mm (10 in) CQC, 368.3 mm (14.5 in) STD, cold hammer-forged, chrome-lined, interchangeable
Cyclic rate of fire: approximately 600 rounds/min

Features: ambidextrous controls, reversible charging handle, side-folding buttstock adjustable to six positions, MIL-STD-1913 Picatinny rails at 12/3/6/9 o'clock, compatible with FN 40GL L MK2 grenade launcher
Models: FN SCAR L MK2 CQC, FN SCAR L MK2 STD

entries.manufacturer: Kurganmashzavod (chassis), Instrument Design Bureau KBP Tula (turret)
entries.description: The BMP-3 is a Russian tracked amphibious infantry fighting vehicle, successor to the BMP-1 and BMP-2, which entered service with the Soviet army in 1990. It is designed to engage armored ground and air targets while stationary, on the move, and afloat. The first export customer was Abu Dhabi (UAE) with an initial order of 330 vehicles delivered between 1992 and 1995.
specs: Armament: one 100mm 2A70 rifled gun/missile launcher, one 30mm 2A72 coaxial cannon, three 7.62mm PKT machine guns
Missile capability: 3UBK10 (9M117, Bastion/AT-10 Stabber) anti-tank guided missile
Armor: welded aluminum alloy, protection against small arms and shell splinters
Speed: 70 km/h on the road, 10 km/h on water
Dimensions: length 7.14 m; width 3.23 m; height 2.65 m
Engine: UTD-29 V-shaped diesel, 500 hp, hydromechanical transmission (4 forward, 2 reverse)
Fully amphibious, propelled by two water jets; dozer blade, NBC system, fire detection/suppression system
Country users: Azerbaijan, Cyprus, Indonesia, Iraq, Kuwait, Libya, Morocco, Nicaragua, Russia, Sri Lanka, South Korea, Turkmenistan, United Arab Emirates, Venezuela
